The affine margin at a coupled midpoint equals the average of the two endpoint margins, so its closed cap indicator is bounded by the sum of the two closed endpoint indicators. Integrating with the fixed coupling gives η(H_0)≤|A∩H_−1|+|B∩H_1| for every ambient affine margin, including equality on boundaries.

A containing ambient halfspace can be narrowed to a parallel halfspace through Y. With nonzero continuous normal, the middle trace is a proper closed halfspace through g, and the weight-two theorem applies with ordinary middle volume k, dominated mass v, and the same ε_d.
